LOOK: Nilinaw ng pamahalaang lungsod ng Maynila na tuloy pa rin ang kanselasyon ng face-to-face classes sa lahat ng antas sa pampubliko at pribadong paaralan ngayong araw, Nov.18 sa lungsod.

data.raw_text:
NEWS UPDATE: Onsite classes in all levels, both in public and private schools, will remain suspended on Tuesday, Nov. 18, to prevent inconvenience and ensure student safety as several areas in Manila remain closed.

The announcement comes after religious group Iglesia Ni Cristo called off its scheduled three-day rally on Monday night.

Classes will continue through alternative modes of learning until Nov. 18.

(Source: Manila Public Information Office)
